map.定性研究路径工具辅助对访谈/观察资料做系统化编码与主题提炼：: The qualitative research path tool helps systematic coding and theme distillation of interview/observation materials:
map.每行首个字段为资料文本，其后逗号分隔的为主题标签；统计各主题出现频次，覆盖率 =: The first field of each row is the material text, followed by comma-separated theme tags; count each theme frequency, coverage = coded entries ÷ total entries, stability judged by appearing ≥3 times.
map.饱和度提示：当连续若干条（默认5）均未出现新主题时，提示可停止抽样。本工具仅做频: Saturation hint: when several consecutive entries (default 5) show no new theme, it hints sampling can stop. This tool only does frequency and coverage statistics; theme distillation still requires the researcher to judge with context.
map.资料条目（每行：资料文本,主题1,主题2,…；逗号分隔，首个为文本，其余为主题）: Material entries (each row: material text, theme1, theme2, …; comma-separated, first is text, rest are themes)

map.定性（研究/方法/分析）路径。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安全: Qualitative (Research / Method / Analysis) Path. Free online tool, processed entirely in the browser, no data uploaded, your privacy and security protected.
map.尚未编码任何主题，无法判断主题饱和。: No themes have been coded yet; saturation cannot be judged.
map.近 5 条均含主题且未出现新主题，主题趋于饱和，可考虑停止抽样。: The last 5 entries all contain themes with no new themes appearing; themes are approaching saturation, so sampling can be considered complete.
map.编码覆盖率 = 已编码条目 ÷ 总条目 × 100%；主题密度 = 总编码数 ÷: Coding coverage = coded entries ÷ total entries × 100%; theme density = total codes ÷ number of entries; appearing ≥ 3 times counts as a stable theme; five consecutive entries without a new theme indicate thematic saturation, at which point sampling can stop
map.📚 深度解析：定性资料的编码覆盖与主题饱和分析: 📚 Deep Dive: Coding Coverage and Thematic Saturation in Qualitative Data
map.把访谈或观察记录逐条录入，每行第一个字段是资料文本、其后是这条资料的主题标签；先: Enter interview or observation records line by line: the first field is the source text, followed by its theme tags. Check coverage first to confirm no whole record was left uncoded.
map.用主题频次 Top10 找出高频主题，把出现 3 次及以上的主题视为稳定主题，作: Use the top-10 theme frequencies to find high-frequency themes; themes appearing 3+ times count as stable and support initial grouping.
map.分批录入资料（如前后两批访谈），对比覆盖率、平均每条目主题数与稳定主题数，并结合: Enter data in batches (e.g. two interview rounds) and compare coverage, average themes per record and stable-theme count, using the saturation hint to judge whether sampling can stop.
map.7 条访谈记录的编码覆盖分析: Coding coverage analysis of 7 interview records
map.逐行录入「访谈A,价格,质量」「访谈B,价格」「访谈C,质量」「访谈D,价格,服: Enter seven lines: "Interview A,price,quality", "Interview B,price", "Interview C,quality", "Interview D,price,service", "Interview E,quality", "Interview F,service", "Interview G" (last row untagged). Result: 7 records, 6 coded, coverage 85.7%, 8 codes total, 1.14 themes per record, 2 stable themes (price, quality), and a warning for 1 uncoded record; no saturation prompt since 5 consecutive records without a new theme is not met. The tool only tallies tags you enter; it does not do open coding or theme extraction.
map.工具能自动做主题提炼或开放编码吗？: Does the tool do theme extraction or open coding automatically?
map.不能。它只统计你已录入的主题标签的覆盖率、频次与饱和度；开放编码、主轴编码与主题: No. It only computes coverage, frequency and saturation from tags you have entered; open coding, axial coding and theme naming still require the researcher's contextual judgement.
map.覆盖率和主题密度分别怎么用？: How are coverage and theme density used?
map.覆盖率＝已编码条目÷总条目，用来发现漏编码的整条资料；主题密度＝总编码数÷条目数: Coverage = coded records ÷ total records, revealing whole records missed during coding; theme density = total codes ÷ records, showing the average number of tags per record. Both depend on the quality of tags entered and are unreliable when tags are missing.
